desc: Replace the earlier 6-state DP plan with the simpler two-parity greedy feasibility check and verify earliest-match safety.
Parse all test cases and extract sorted positions of 1s in A and B in O(sum N).
Reject immediately when count(B)>count(A) or span(B)>span(A).
Implement feasible(p) scanning A gaps and matching current B gap if d>g or (d==g and parity(B[j]-A[t])==p).
Compute base=max(B[0]-A[0], A[-1]-B[-1]) and choose base/base+1/-1 using feasible(base%2) and feasible(1-base%2).

Test edge cases (M=1, K=M, no unchanged gaps, parity conflicts, impossible gap capacity, N=1) and sample tests; if failures occur, switch to an alternative approach rather than refining the same greedy.
